description: This file defines the ContentDao interface, which declares data access methods for Content, ContentDescription, and related entities in the content management module of the shopizer project.

classes.name: ContentDao
classes.description: Interface for data access operations related to Content entities.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by type, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by multiple content types, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object by its code and store.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a Content object by its code, store, and language.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by type and store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Content objects filtered by type and store.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists ContentDescription objects for specific content types, store, and language, excluding non-visible content.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves Content for a given ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Fetches ContentDescription by store and SEO URL.
